load.name: Load
load.desc: Load average against the number of CPU cores.

swap.name: Swap
swap.desc: Share of swap space in use.

psi.name: Pressure
psi.desc: Time tasks waited for CPU, memory or disk over the last minute (PSI).

oom.name: Out-of-memory kills
oom.desc: Processes the kernel killed for lack of memory in the last 24 hours.

fs.name: Disk space
fs.desc: Space and inodes used on each local filesystem.

path.name: Folder size
path.desc: Size of a project folder and its largest subfolders.

big.name: Large logs
big.desc: Log files over 500 MB in /var/log, Docker container logs and project storage/logs folders.

df.name: Docker storage
df.desc: Space used by Docker images, containers, volumes and build cache.

compose.name: Compose containers
compose.desc: State, restarts and memory of a Compose project's containers.

app.name: pm2 app
app.desc: Status and restarts of a pm2 process.

size.name: Database size
size.desc: Size of a database and its largest tables.

miner.name: Crypto miner
miner.desc: Known miner processes and programs running from deleted files.

upload_php.name: PHP in uploads
upload_php.desc: PHP files inside upload or public storage folders.

preload.name: ld.so.preload
preload.desc: Whether /etc/ld.so.preload has content, a common rootkit trick.

ports.name: Open database ports
ports.desc: Database and Docker ports listening on all interfaces.

recent_change.name: Recent code changes
recent_change.desc: Code files changed in the last 3 days, outside vendor folders.

http.name: HTTP
http.desc: Status code, response time and final address of the site.

tls.name: Certificate
tls.desc: Days until the TLS certificate expires, and whether it is trusted.

exposed.name: Exposed files
exposed.desc: Whether /.env or /.git/HEAD can be downloaded from the site.

toolbar.orderHolds: Card order holds until the scan ends

overview.firstScan: No scans yet. Press Scan all to read your servers.

sys.psi: Processes are waiting for CPU, memory or disk
sys.oom: {n} process was killed for lack of memory | {n} processes were killed for lack of memory

sec.ports: Port {target} is open to the internet

error.ssh_auth: SSH did not accept your key. Make sure it is loaded in your agent and added on the server.
error.ssh_host_key_unknown: This server is not in known_hosts yet. Check its fingerprint, then connect once from Terminal to trust it.
error.ssh_host_key_changed: The server's host key changed. Do not continue until you know why.
error.ssh_unreachable: Couldn’t reach the server over SSH. Check the address and your network.
error.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
error.nothing_to_scan: There is nothing to scan. Add a host or a project first.
error.local_network_down: This Mac looks offline. Check your network and scan again.
error.config_invalid: Couldn’t read {path}. Fix the file or move it aside.
error.config_invalid_at: Couldn’t read {path} at line {line}. Fix the file or move it aside.
error.config_from_newer_version: {path} was written by a newer Daminus (version {version}). Update Daminus to edit it.
error.config_changed_on_disk: {path} changed on disk. Reload it before saving.
error.store_busy: Daminus is busy with another operation. Try again in a moment.
error.secret_access_denied: Daminus has no access to the key stored in Keychain.
error.provider_auth: The AI provider rejected the key. Check it in Settings.
error.provider_rate_limit: The AI provider is limiting requests. Try again in a minute.
error.provider_unavailable: The AI provider is not reachable right now.
error.schema_invalid: The AI answer was not in the expected format.
error.internal: Something went wrong inside Daminus. The log has the details.

command.name: Command
command.removed: {n} hidden or control character was removed. | {n} hidden or control characters were removed.

risk.pipeToShell: It pipes what it downloads straight into a shell, so you never see what runs.
risk.base64Decode: It decodes hidden text. Check what the text turns into before you run it.
risk.remove: It deletes files. Check the path before you run it.
